title: Ranikhet | The Queen’s Meadow in Uttarakhand, Things to Do, Best Time to Visit & Travel Guide
content:
Ranikhet - Uttarkhand,

Ranikhet, also known as the “Queen’s Meadow”, is one of those places where time feels slow and peaceful. Sitting at an altitude of about 1,869 meters in the Almora district, it gives clear views of the Himalayas, including the mighty Nanda Devi Peak.

The story goes that Rani Padmini, the queen of Kumaon, loved this place so much that it was named Ranikhet after her. Today, it is home to the Kumaon Regiment Headquarters and has a strong army presence, which keeps the town clean and organized.

Unlike busy hill stations like Nainital or Mussoorie, Ranikhet is quiet. You’ll find pine forests, apple orchards, old temples, and colonial-style houses here. Walking around the town feels refreshing, with the cool mountain air and the sound of birds around you. It’s a wonderful place for families, couples, or even solo travelers who want a break from city life.

Best Time to Visit:

  • March - June (Peak Season): Weather is cool and pleasant (15°C–25°C). Perfect for walks, sightseeing, and spending time outdoors.
  • September - November (Moderate Season): Skies are clear (10°C–20°C). Great time for nature photography and calm vacations.
  • December - February (Low Season): Cold (0°C–10°C), sometimes with snowfall. A good choice if you love winter feel.

Distance from City Center:

Ranikhet town itself is the center, and most sights like Jhula Devi Temple and Chaubatia Gardens are within 2–10 km from the main market.

Timings & Entry Fee:

  • Timings: Ranikhet is open all year round.
  • Entry Fee: No entry fee (only some gardens or parking areas may have small charges).

Things to Do in Ranikhet:

  • Visit Jhula Devi Temple, where thousands of bells are tied as offerings.
  • Walk through Chaubatia Gardens, famous for apple orchards and fruit plantations.
  • Spend quiet time near Bhalu Dam, a hidden lake surrounded by forests.
  • Offer prayers at Haidakhan Temple, with peaceful surroundings.
  • Visit the Army Golf Course, one of the highest in Asia, and enjoy the views.
  • Take slow walks through pine forests and enjoy the calm air.
  • Shop at the local market for woolens, handmade candles, and Kumaoni food items.
  • Wake up early to watch the sunrise over the Himalayan peaks.

Top 10 Places to Visit Near Ranikhet (within 50 km):

1- Majkhali (12 km): Famous for clear Himalayan views.

2- Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary (50 km): Best for trekking and wildlife lovers.

3- Katarmal Sun Temple (25 km): An ancient temple dedicated to the Sun God.

4- Almora (46 km): Cultural town with old markets and temples.

5- Dwarahat (38 km): Known for its group of ancient temples.

6- Kalika (10 km): A small town with a famous Devi temple.

7- Bhalu Dam (3 km): Calm picnic spot near Ranikhet.

8- Sitlakhet (35 km): Small forested village with peaceful vibes.

9- Someshwar (13 km): Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.

10- Kausani (59 km): A little farther, but very famous for sunrise views.
excerpt: Ranikhet is a peaceful hill station with forests, temples, orchards, and Himalayan views. It’s quieter than Nainital, making it perfect for anyone who wants to relax and enjoy nature at their own pace.
